source: Medieval II: Total War Mobile - ModDB

mods.title: Secession: Civil War Original (mobile)
mods.description: The original Secession: Civil War mod for Medieval II: Total War, made by the team at MundusBellicus. Includes new factions and custom battles; no campaign.

mods.title: Stainless Steel Historical Improvement Project (Mobile)
mods.description: An ambitious, large-scale mod based on Stainless Steel 6.4, aiming to deliver a historically detailed early-era campaign.

mods.title: Stainless Steel 6.4
mods.description: A combination of bug fixes, gameplay improvements, better AI, more provinces, graphical improvements, and campaign and battle-map changes.

mods.title: JLMPs Vanilla Kingdoms 2023
mods.description: Vanilla and Kingdoms combined, with countless bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

mods.title: Tsardoms Total War (mobile)
mods.description: A M2TW and Kingdoms modification focused on the Balkans, Near East, and Eastern and Central Europe, including Italy and Switzerland.

mods.title: Insularis Draco (mobile)
mods.description: A historical overhaul featuring 30 playable factions and four detailed maps of north-western Europe, covering 355–700 AD.

mods.title: Rule Britannia 1.7
mods.description: The full version of the Rule Britannia 1.7 mod.

mods.title: Rise of the Eagles (mobile)
mods.description: A Napoleonic-era mod set between 1806 and 1821, exploring the possibilities of a European Empire under Napoleon I.

mods.title: Vanilla Reskin & Rebalance (mobile)
mods.description: Reskins vanilla units for a more historical look and adjusts several gameplay and balance issues.

mods.title: Bare Geomod
mods.description: A basic mod setup for Medieval II: Total War Mobile.

mods.title: Broken Crescent 2.4.2
mods.description: A total conversion centred on the Middle East, starting in 1174 and concluding in 1300.

mods.title: The spring and autumn of five dynasties (Mobile)
mods.description: A mobile port of the Five Dynasties mod. The listing notes that official game version 1.5 is needed to play normally.

mods.title: La Guerre de Cent Ans - The Hundred Years War (Mobile)
mods.description: A campaign set in 1337–1453, featuring England, France, and several satellite factions including Aragon, Burgundy, Flanders, and the Holy Roman Empire.

mods.title: Europe Ancient (Rome 1 on Medieval II Mobile)
mods.description: A project that brings a Rome 1-style setting to the Medieval II engine.

mods.title: Sengoku
mods.description: A mod set during the Sengoku Jidai in feudal Japan.

mods.title: Kingdoms Grand Campaign Mod 5.0
mods.description: Adds Kingdoms units into the Grand Campaign, with an expanded epic map and two turns per year starting in 1180.

mods.title: Clouds across Europe 2.0
mods.description: A compatibility-focused release based on the original 1.4 mod, with edits to improve compatibility.
